entries: Balaur can jump up to 30 ft. and has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to falling damage.

action.name: Pair Bonding
entries: Balaur grants another allied Balaur within 60 ft. {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that Balaur's attacks and Saving Throws until the start of this Balaur's next turn.

action.name: Twin Claw Grapple
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Twin Spirited
entries: The first time Balaur is reduced to 0 hit points, so long as it used Pair Bonding at least once, or was the target of another Balaur's Pair Bonding, it is revived with full {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} although it has an ethereal ghost-like appearance. Its Twin Claw Grapple attack now deals Necrotic damage instead of Piercing damage.

trait.name: Peaceful Aura, Fearsome Presence
entries: Beipiaosaurus is a docile creature, calmly feeding on vegetation in the chilly mountains of Yixian. However, if attacked, Beipiaosaurus will erupt into a frenzy of slashing claws. The first time Beipiaosaurus is attacked, the attacking creature must succeed a {@dc 12} Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} or has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Slow Metabolism
entries: Beipiaosaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Saving Throws to prevent the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. However, if it does become {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the duration of that condition is doubled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Beipiaosaurus makes two Sabre-Clawed Slash attacks.

action.name: Sabre-Clawed Slash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, plus: {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Slashing damage.

items.name: Predatory Ancestors
entries: Beipiaosaurus retains the nocturnal hunter-killer instincts of its predatory theropod ancestors. At night, Beipiaosaurus gains the following temporary changes:

items: It has Darkvision 60 ft.
Its movement speed is 35 ft. and its climb speed is 20 ft.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Perception checks.
It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
It has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Radiant damage.
It has an aversion to bright light.
It loses its "Peaceful Aura, Fearsome Presence" Trait.

trait.name: Steady Healing
entries: At the end of Big Al's turn, she recovers 8 lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Big Al has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage (included above).

trait.name: Clumsy
entries: Whenever Big Al begins moving, roll a {@dice D20}. On the roll of a 1, Big Al instead stumbles and trips directly forward 10 ft, has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, takes {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage, and her speed becomes 0 until the end of her turn.
If Big Al is below 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, she stumbles on a roll of 1-10, rather than just 1.

trait.name: Subadult
entries: Big Al's Wisdom Ability Score is reduced to 6 (included above) and she cannot gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Wisdom checks or Wisdom Saving Throws.

trait.name: Stalker
entries: The first time each day that Big Al fails a {@skill Stealth|XPHB} check, she can instead choose to succeed it.

trait.name: Starving
entries: The first time an {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB} check is made against Big Al each day, if that check utilises food suitable for a carnivore, it automatically succeeds.
If Big Al is fed, she'll periodically return to whoever fed her of her own accord for more food.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Big Al makes one Big Al's Maw attack and one Big Al's Claws attack.

action.name: Big Al's Maw
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+7, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Big Al's Claws
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+7, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Slashing damage.

items.name: Big Al's Ballad
entries: When Big Al awakens at dawn each day or is in combat, dramatic orchestral music plays loudly centred over her location and all of Big Al's choices, thoughts, and actions are also narrated by a disembodied, stoic British voice. This music and voice can only be heard by player characters.

items.name: Story Set in Stone
entries: Big Al cannot be killed by normal means. If Big Al is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or suffers an effect that would kill her, she instead falls to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}, cannot attack, loses her Steady {@variantrule Healing|XPHB} Trait, and will flee from combat.

She can only take lethal damage from her Clumsy Trait. If she does not trip while fleeing, she will wander for 24 hours, then die emaciated on the nearest riverbank. However, if Big Al is healed during this 24 hour period (excluding from a Short/{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}), she regains her Steady {@variantrule Healing|XPHB} Trait, is able to attack again, and may behave normally.

trait.name: Altruistic Behaviour
entries: When attacked, a herd of Bolong will tend to flee. However, one will always stay behind to buy time for the others to escape. That Bolong will attack and fight to the death. The other individuals will only fight if they are cornered or cannot escape.

action.name: Crushing Bulk
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If Bolong moved 20+ ft. straight towards the hit creature, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Bludgeoning damage and Bolong takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thumb Gouge
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Defensive Gouge
entries: {@actTrigger} Bolong is hit by a Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB} within 5 ft. {@actResponse} Bolong may make a Thumb Gouge attack at the attacking creature.

items.name: Dragon's Legacy
entries: Bolong has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage.

items.name: Bo's Dragon {@recharge 4}
entries: Bolong spits a ball of burning ash at a point within 20 ft. of it. The ground within a 10 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} from that point is engulfed in burning embers and flame.

For the next minute, any creature that starts its turn within or moves into the embers suffers the following: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Titanic Fighter
entries: Carcharodontosaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures with a size category of Large, Huge, or Gargantuan. Carcharodontosaurus also has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Slashing damage (included above).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Carcharodontosaurus fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB}, it can choose to succeed it instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Carcharodontosaurus makes three Ripping Bite attacks.

action.name: Ripping Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) Piercing damage and the 'Torn' condition (see below).

entries.name: Condition: Torn
entries: A torn creature has had a large piece of flesh ripped away from its body and is bleeding heavily.
At the start of its turn in combat or every minute outside of combat, the creature suffers the following effect:
{@actSave str} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.
This condition persists until one of the following occurs:

items: The creature is healed by at least 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
The creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} (do not make saves while resting but begin again if the rest is interrupted).
A {@dc 18} {@skill Medicine|XPHB} check is passed on the creature.
A {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell is cast on the creature.
It dies.

items.name: Hyper Adaptations
entries: You may choose or roll for one major mutation and two minor mutations (see Mesozoic Reptiles in Your Worlds). Carcharodontosaurus gains these mutations.

items.name: Adapt
entries: Roll a {@dice d20}, on a 10 to 20, you may replace one of Carcharodontosaurus' mutations with another of your choice from the same table. On the roll of a 1 to 9 you must replace one of Carcharodontosaurus' mutations with another randomly determined mutation from the same table.

trait.name: Olfactory Enlargement
entries: Carnotaurus has a +10 bonus to any {@skill Perception|XPHB} check that involves smell. If its sense of smell is hindered or lost, it instead has a -10 modifier and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on any {@skill Perception|XPHB} check that involves smell.

trait.name: Scent of Prey
entries: Carnotaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Survival checks to pursue prey.

trait.name: Possible Pack Mentality
entries: All Carnotaurus treat other Carnotaurus as allies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Carnotaurus makes two Slashing Bite attacks and one Brow Horn Gore attack.

action.name: Slashing Bite
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+4, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Brow Horn Gore
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+6, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Explosive Ambush!
entries: If it is the first round of combat, Carnotaurus takes the Dash action.

items.name: Venerated Headwear
entries: Local people venerate the Carnotaurus and worship them by adorning them with a variety of headdresses as they sleep. This is seen as a right-of-passage or coming-of-age ceremony by some cultures and is a test of an individual's stealth and sleight of hand. With Carnotaurus' short arms unable to reach its head, headwear may stay on one for several weeks or months. This headwear is often crafted from expensive silks or inlaid with precious gemstones and can be highly valuable (we recommend a value of {@dice 2d100 + 50} GP). This leads to Carnotaurus sometimes being targeted by bandits for raids which, more often than not, results in an easy meal for the Carnotaurus.
Stolen headdresses are seen as contraband by their respective cultures.

items.name: A Familiar Smell
entries: Carnotaurus becomes accustomed to the smell of its Venerated Headwear and will instinctively follow its scent if stolen. A player or NPC harbouring stolen Venerated Headwear will be hunted by its respective Carnotaurus. That Carnotaurus automatically passes any {@skill Perception|XPHB} check to detect its Venerated Headwear that involves smell.

If that Carnotaurus is alive and not {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, roll a {@dice D6} whenever the harbouring player/NPC takes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. On a 5 or 6, the Carnotaurus interrupts and attacks them during that {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: Frill Shield
entries: If Centrosaurus is facing the direction that an attack originated from, increase Centrosaurus' AC by 2 against that attack.

trait.name: Tenacious Herbivore
entries: Centrosaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom Saving Throws.

action.name: Horn Swipe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., up to two targets. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Horn Charge
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) Piercing damage.
Centrosaurus may only use this attack if it moved at least 20 ft. in a straight line before reaching the target on this turn.

bonus.name: Dazzling Display
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 10}, each enemy creature within a 30 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of that can see Centrosaurus. {@actSaveFail} {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all Saving Throws for 1 minute.

items.name: Mirror Image: Monoclonius (1/day)
entries: Centrosaurus casts {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB} (level 2 version) without requiring components or a spell slot. Each illusion persists for 24 hours, rather than 1 minute.
When approaching a herd of Centrosaurus, at least one will already have this spell active.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Chronoficer casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Ticking Clock (3/Day)
entries: Before rolling, the Chronoficer may choose to instead treat any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} as a 10 instead of rolling.

trait.name: Temporal Cerebral Destabilisation
entries: The Chronoficer is immune to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition and mind control effects, but must be a chaotic alignment (included above).

action.name: Pistol of Timewarping
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 40 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Temporal Rift (1/Day, or as narrative permits)
entries: The Chronoficer opens a temporal rift. The rift functions as a portal and leads to a different time period (DM's choice if this is controlled by the Chronoficer or is random). The rift functions in one of the following ways (DM's choice):

items: A stable portal opens within 20 ft. of the Chronoficer. A creature of any size can pass through in either direction. This persists until deactivated by a control device in the Chronoficer's possession.

A portal tied to a large, often immobile, device opens for 10 minutes. During this time, a creature of any size small enough to pass through the device can pass through the portal in either direction.
A small portal opens within 20 ft. of the Chronoficer that allows several (usually 5-6) Medium or smaller creatures to pass through before closing.

action.name: Gadget (3/Day)
entries: In addition to the Chronficer's spellcasting, they may use a series of gadgets to assist them while exploring new environments. They may select one of the following spells and cast it as a Magic action without requiring components or a spell slot. They may only target themselves with these spells.

items: {@spell Water Breathing|XPHB}
{@spell Jump|XPHB}
{@spell Spider Climb|XPHB}
{@spell Darkvision|XPHB}

trait.name: Mysterious Hump: Display
entries: Concavenator has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.

trait.name: Mysterious Hump: Fatty Storage
entries: Concavenator only needs to drink once per month.

trait.name: Muscular Forearms
entries: Concavenator has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any check or {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} to avoid the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Combined Claw and Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Mysterious Hump: Micro-thermoregulation
entries: Trigger: Concavenator is hit by an attack or fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Concavenator has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold or Fire damage until the end of the turn.

items.name: Landshark
entries: Concavenator gains Tremorsense 30 ft. and a burrow speed of 30 ft., but cannot burrow through solid stone. While burrowing, it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} (although its general location is revealed by its protruding hump, which glides along the ground).

items.name: Burrowing Dive
entries: Concavenator burrows downwards deeper underground, preparing to strike its next target. It has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} and cannot attack or be attacked (other burrowing creatures ignore this).

At the start of Concavenator's next turn, it bursts upwards, unearthing itself and ending its burrowing. Until the end of that turn, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks and cannot use its Burrowing Dive action.

trait.name: Constructed
entries: When a Construct of Flesh is created, the Bonesmith who created it chooses one of the abilities listed below and one of the attacks. The Construct of Flesh only has the chosen Trait and attack.

trait.name: Arboreal
entries: Construct of Flesh gains a climb speed of 30 ft. and has advantage on {@skill Athletics|XPHB} and {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB} checks.

trait.name: Volant
entries: Construct of Flesh gains a fly speed of 30 ft.

trait.name: Nocturnal
entries: Construct of Flesh gains {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} (120 ft.) and has advantage on {@skill Stealth|XPHB} and {@skill Perception|XPHB} checks.

trait.name: Robust
entries: Construct of Flesh's AC is increased to 17 and its maximum hit points are increased to 5 + 7*Your Fighter Level.

trait.name: Nimble
entries: Construct of Flesh's speed is increased to 45 ft. and its Dexterity Ability Score is increased by 2. If it succeeds a Dexterity saving throw to avoid half incoming damage, it instead avoids all of that damage.

action.name: Vicious Bite
entries: {@atkr m} +(4 + PB) to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 +  PB} Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage, plus: {@actSave con} DC (your spell save DC). {@actSaveFail} {@damage 2d4} Poison damage.

action.name: Mighty Gore
entries: {@atkr m} +(4 + PB) to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 +  PB} Bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage, plus: {@actSave str} DC (your spell save DC). {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Noxious Spit
entries: {@atkr r} +(4 + PB) to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 +  PB} Acid damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Gruesome Claw
entries: {@atkr m} +(4 + PB) to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 +  PB} Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage, plus: {@actSave wis} (your spell save DC). {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of the hit creature's next turn.

trait.name: Swooping Flight
entries: So long as Cratoavis is flying and it moved last turn, its AC is increased by 3 and it does not provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Charming Display (2/Day)
entries: Cratoavis casts {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} (level 1 version, {@dc 15}). A {@condition Charmed|XPHB} humanoid must attempt to provide food to Cratoavis.

action.name: Toothed Peck
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft, one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d2 + 1}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Global Adventurer
entries: If Cratoavis successfully charms a member of the party, it will then begin to follow the party if able, keeping a reasonable distance from them (>50 ft.) for most of the time.
Unless it is regularly fed, once per day it will attempt to perform a Charming Display to either a party member or another humanoid it encounters.

items.name: Perfect Preservation
entries: If Cratoavis is slain, its body does not decay or deteriorate in any way, and it instead enters a state of preservational stasis. While in this state, it is {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} and can be revived by receiving any healing from a magical source.

trait.name: Wader
entries: Deinocheirus can move through water up to 5 ft. deep without being slowed or having to swim.

trait.name: Pennaceous Display Feathers
entries: Deinocheirus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intimidation and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} checks.

trait.name: Mud Raker
entries: If a single creature is hit by both of Deinocheirus' Terrible Claw attacks in a single turn, they take an additional {@damage 1d6} Poison damage, as the dregged mud from its claws coats their wounds.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Deinocheirus makes two Terrible Claw attacks.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d12 + 3}) Slashing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target drops and item they are wielding.

bonus.name: Grasping Tongue
entries: Deinocheirus picks up an item up to 20 lb. in weight with its tongue and wields it (it may only wield one item at a time). If that item is a weapon that does not require ammunition, Deinocheirus may attack with it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} (it does not have proficiency/training with weapons).

items.name: Swamp Lord
entries: Deinocheirus has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold and Poison damage.

items.name: Swampy Vomit {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 40 ft. long, 5 ft. wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Poison damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Hyper Resilience
entries: Deinosuchus' remarkable immune system and colossal bulk render it resistant to all damage and it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (included above).

trait.name: Aquatic Ambush Predator
entries: Deinosuchus can hold its breath for up to 1 hour and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Stealth checks while submerged in water.

action.name: Bone-Crushing Bite
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, one creature within 10 ft. ({@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if size Large or larger). {@actSaveFail} 56 ({@damage 8d10 + 12}) Piercing damage plus the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions (escape {@dc 20}). Deinosuchus cannot target any other creature with its Bone-Crushing Bite until the Grapple ends.

legendary.name: Thrash
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each other creature in a 10 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} (no save allowed if {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by Deinosuchus). {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 2d20}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Deathroll
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 21}, a creature currently {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by Deinosuchus. {@actSaveFail} 39 ({@damage 6d12}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Deinosuchus cannot use this Legendary Action next round.

items.name: Regional Demigod
entries: Deinosuchus is worshiped by local humanoids as the embodiment of primal power and is accompanied by an entourage of humanoids that adorn it with giant flower rings, vividly coloured paints, and fine silks, and ritualistically clean its teeth as it basks in the sun.

Deinosuchus will not attack humanoids unless in self-defence and it is considered an extreme offence to these people to disrespect or attack Deinosuchus. Typically, these humanoids will demand an offering of food for Deinosuchus to safely pass through its territory.

trait.name: Apparent Fragility
entries: Dilophosaurus appears to be a fragile animal, but it is in fact much hardier than it looks. The first time Dilophosaurus is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it is reduced to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead. Once this occurs, Dilophosaurus must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before it can use this Trait again.

trait.name: Agile Hunter
entries: Dilophosaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity Saving Throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dilophosaurus makes (A) one Recurved Bite attack and one Dexterous Claws attack, or (B) one Neck Sweep attack.

action.name: Recurved Bite
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+5, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}, a Medium or smaller creature. {@actSaveFail} The hit creature drops an item it is wielding.

action.name: Dextrous Claws
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+5, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage. Dilophosaurus cannot use this attack if it is {@variantrule Grappling|XPHB} a creature.

action.name: Neck Sweep
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 10 ft. {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage and the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Dual Skull Crests
entries: Dilophosaurus flushes its crests with blood, giving them a bold red colour. It gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intimidation checks for 1 minute.

bonus.name: Grasping Forelimbs
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+5, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Anthesis to Spitting
entries: Dilophosaurus could never spit venom and it despises all suggestions that it should. This has given it an innate magical aura that protects it from similar attacks. All ranged attacks against Dilophosaurus are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. Additionally, Dilophosaurus has immunity to Poison and Acid damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Dr Dhrolin's casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Action Surge (1/Day)
entries: Dr Dhrolin can take one additional {@variantrule Action|XPHB} this turn.

trait.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
entries: Dr Dhrolin has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage (included above).

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: Dr Dhrolin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves against the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage (included above).

trait.name: Geologist
entries: When travelling underground, Dr Dhrolin always knows his position relative to where he entered, and always knows what time of day it is.

He has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any {@skill History|XPHB} or {@skill Investigation|XPHB} checks that involve rocks, fossils, or stonework. He knows the value of any fossil, gemstones, or mineral at a glance.

trait.name: Fortune Favours the Bold (2/Day)
entries: Dr Dhrolin may choose to re-roll a single {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, or force a creature to reroll a single {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, so long as it is a roll for an attack, spell, or effect that Dr Dhrolin is a target of.

action.name: Trusty Rusty
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) Piercing damage.
Trusty Rusty can be used as an Arcane Focus by Dr Dhrolin, grants {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures made of stone or earth, and can be used as a tool for mining and digging.
This weapon scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20.

action.name: Throwing Axe
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 25 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Interpret Beast
entries: Dr Dhrolin examines a beast that he can see within 50 ft. He learns how difficult of a fight it would pose (its CR) and one of its abilities (determined at random). Once he interprets a beast, he cannot interpret it (or any beasts using the same stat block) again.

bonus.name: Second Wind (1/Day)
entries: Dr Dhrolin regains {@dice 1d10 + 4} lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Dromeus Emissary casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Diplomatic Immunity
entries: Dromeus Emissary is always considered to be friendly to law enforcement - guards of any kind will defend it if able. Dromeus Emissary is also immune to charm effects.

trait.name: Global Migrator
entries: Dromeus Emissary has {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in Athletics (included above).

action.name: Letter Opener
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Dromeus Memory-Keeper casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Mind's Eye
entries: Dromeus Memory-Keeper is able to glimpse into the thoughts of nearby creatures, so long as they are focused on it. Melee attacks against Dromeus Memory-Keeper are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and Dromeus Memory-Keeper has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence Saving Throws.

trait.name: Split Focus
entries: Dromeus Memory-Keeper may make an attack with its Ceremonial Memory-Channelling Staff as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Global Migrator
entries: Dromeus Memory-Keeper has {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in Athletics (included above).

bonus.name: Ceremonial Memory-Channelling Staff
entries: {@atk rw} +8, range 50 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage, plus: {@actSave int} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Haggle
entries: Dromeus Trader has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Persuasion checks while negotiating prices.

trait.name: Uncommon Wares
entries: You may select one common or uncommon magic item for Dromeus Trader to have (DM's choice). It may use that item and can be convinced to sell it.

trait.name: Global Trader
entries: Dromeus Trader has {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in Athletics (included above) and may remove a level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} after completing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Bag'o'Coins
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Bludgeoning damage.
When a creature is hit by this attack {@dice 1d6} coins are scattered on the ground. Roll {@dice 1d4} and consult the list below to determine the type of coins:

items: Copper
Silver
Gold
Mysterious

trait.name: Top Triassic Predator
entries: Erythrosuchus was the top predator of its time, but only predated upon animals a similar size or smaller than itself. Erythrosuchus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against Medium and Large creatures, but {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures of any other size category.
Semi-arid Inhabitant. Erythrosuchus only needs to drink water once every few weeks.

trait.name: Unknown Predatory Style
entries: If Erythrosuchus chooses the Dash action, it may still make a single attack with its Monstrous Jaw as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Erythrosuchus fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB}, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Erythrosuchus makes two Monstrous Jaw attacks.

action.name: Monstrous Jaw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Erythrosuchus cannot target any other creature with its Monstrous Jaw attack until the Grapple ends.

legendary.name: Ripping Thrash
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, a creature that Erythrosuchus is currently {@variantrule Grappling|XPHB}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Slashing damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: Drag Away
entries: Erythrosuchus may move up to 20 ft., dragging a {@condition Grappled|XPHB} creature along with it. Any creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by Erythrosuchus is moved with it.

items.name: Maw of Madness
entries: A creature bit by Erythrosuchus' Monstrous Jaw attack suffers the following effect:

{@actSave wis} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The hit creature's Intelligence score is reduced to 3 for 1 minute. During this time, their PB is 0, they cannot speak, read, write, understand language, and may only act on their instincts.

trait.name: Fruitbringer
entries: When Falcatakely is first encountered, it will always carry a berry or fruit in its mouth. If players approach it, it will fly to a nearby tree or bush, revealing an abundance of delicious fruits/berries that can provide rations for four people for up to two days.

trait.name: Morning Chorus
entries: As dawn breaks, Falcatakely makes loud chirping noises that can be heard for up to 300 ft.

trait.name: Island Isolation
entries: Falcatakely found on an island will be different colours from, and produce a different chorus to, those found on the mainland.

action.name: Recurved Peck
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d2}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Bountiful Harvest
entries: Falcatakely radiate druidic energies and their presence increases the yield of all surrounding plants. If Falcatakely is present in an environment for more than a week, all plants in the local region double the amount of fruit, berries, and flowers they produce. This effect diminishes and productivity returns to normal over the course of a week if Falcatakely leaves the area.
Islands inhabited by colonies of many Falcatakely are usually tropical paradises.

items.name: Familiar
entries: Falcatakely may be used as a familiar via the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell or any similar effect. If you do so, we recommend that its Fruitbringer Trait only activates each time it is summoned in a new area.

trait.name: Lock Jaw
entries: If Garjainia hits a creature with its Over-Sized Bite attack, it can opt to grasp onto it. While grasping, if either Garjainia or the hit creature attempts to move, they must make contested Strength checks. Whichever creature loses the contested Strength check has its speed reduced to 0 until its next turn. If Garjainia or the grasped creature moves, the other moves with it (without using any of its own movement) and is considered to be occupying the same space as it.

As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, the hit creature may make a {@dc 14} Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} to remove Garjainia, ending this effect and pushing Garjainia 5 ft. directly away from it on a success. Alternatively, Garjainia may choose to end this effect at any time.

action.name: Over-Sized Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) Piercing plus when a creature is hit by this attack, roll a {@dice d3} and consult the list below, applying the effect to the hit creature so long as Garjainia is grasping it (see Lock Jaw).

items: Bitten body. The creature suffers an additional 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.
Bitten arm. Melee, ranged, and spell attacks made by the creature are at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
Bitten leg. Halve the current speed of the creature.

entries: Garjainia can only cause one of these effects at a time.

bonus.name: High-Gait Scramble {@recharge 4}
entries: Garjainia takes the Dash action.

items.name: Power Syphon
entries: Each time a creature is hit by Over-Sized Bite attack, roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 1-10, nothing happens. On a roll of 11-20, the hit creature expends one unused spell slot (determined at random).

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small beast. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

The swarm has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Petrified|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions (included above).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Garjainia (Swarm) makes four Over-Sized Bite attacks.

action.name: Over-Sized Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14})

bonus.name: High-Gait Scramble {@recharge 4}
entries: Garjainia (Swarm) takes the Dash action.

trait.name: Overview
entries: Giraffatitan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Perception checks that involve sight.

trait.name: Enormous*
entries: Giraffatitan has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage (included above). Giraffatitan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Saving Throws to resist the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} conditions, but automatically fails any Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Giraffatitan makes one Neck Sweep attack and one Chomp attack.

action.name: Neck Sweep
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft., up to three targets. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Evolutionary Arms Race
entries: Each time Giraffatitan is hit by an attack or fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB}, roll on the Minor Mutation Table and apply the result to Giraffatitan, rerolling if Giraffatitan already has the effect that the mutation would confer.
Alternatively, instead of using the Minor Mutation Table you may increase the reach of both of Giraffatitan's attacks by 5 ft.
Giraffatitan gains the mutation or increased attack range for 1 hour.

trait.name: Crop
entries: Hatzegopteryx has a large throat pouch called a Crop that is able to hold a Medium or smaller sized creature (see Swallow to Crop). There is only enough air within the crop to breathe for 1 minute.
While a creature is inside its crop, Hatzegopteryx's fly speed is reduced by half, it cannot take the Dash action, and it will generally attempt to flee a fight to keep its meal.
If Hatzegopteryx becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, it immediately regurgitates any creature in its Crop.
Hatzegopteryx cannot make Dexterity Saving Throws against attacks, spells, or effects that originated from within its Crop.

trait.name: Evasive Flying
entries: If Hatzegopteryx makes a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} while flying to take only half damage from an attack, spell, or effect, it instead takes no damage if the {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} is succeeded.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Hatzegopteryx fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB}, it can instead choose to succeed.

trait.name: Heavy Flier
entries: Hatzegopteryx can only begin flying by using its Quad Launch Legendary Action, or if it is falling. Hatzegopteryx has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Thunder damage (included above).

action.name: Grounded Multiattack
entries: Hatzegopteryx makes one Beak Spear attack and two Beak Flurry attacks. It may only use Grounded Multiattack if it is standing on the ground.

action.name: Beak Spear
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 5d8 + 8}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Beak Flurry
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Swallow to Crop
entries: Strength or Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} (target's choice): {@dc 16}, a Medium or smaller creature within 10 ft. that has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition (Hatzegopteryx can only have one creature in its Crop at a time). {@actSaveFail} The creature is swallowed into the Crop, has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and {@condition Blinded|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from attacks and effects outside of Hatzegopteryx, and takes {@damage 4d4} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns (escape {@dc 17} Strength Check).

legendary.name: Quad Launch (Hatzegopteryx)
entries: If it is standing on the ground, Hatzegopteryx launches itself into the air. {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, each other creature in a 10 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Hatzegopteryx flies 20 ft. in a straight line. Hatzegopteryx cannot use this Legendary Action in the next round.

items.name: Unnatural Resistance
entries: Hatzegopteryx has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

items.name: Sonic Shockwave (1/Day)
entries: Hatzegopteryx flies supersonically. Its fly speed is increased to 600 ft. and, if it flies its maximum fly distance in a straight line, it may emit a Sonic Shockwave at any point along that route: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, each other creature in a 120 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 52 ({@damage 12d8}) Thunder damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.
Hatzegopteryx may only perform a Sonic Shockwave if there are no creatures in its Crop and it cannot take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} until its next turn.

items.name: Screech
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each other creature within a 60 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Thunder damage and the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature may repeat this {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} at the end of each of their turns. {@actSaveSuccess} {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition effects of Screech for 24 hours.

trait.name: Bipedal Shift
entries: If Iguanodon takes the Dash action, its base speed is increased to 40 ft. until the start of its next turn (dashing up to 80 ft.).
Ossified Tendons: Iguanodon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength Saving Throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Iguanodon makes two Thumb Gore attacks and one Bulk Throw attack.

action.name: Thumb Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Bulk Throw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
If Iguanodon misses with its Bulk Throw attack, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Bellow Cheeks
entries: Iguanodon inflates its cheeks and makes a loud bellowing sound. Each other Iguanodon within a 500 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} becomes aware that it is in danger and will either flock to help or flee the area.

items.name: Crystal Palace Horned History
entries: You may choose for Iguanodon to have a much more lizard-like appearance and a large, pointed horn on its snout instead of clawed thumbs. If you do, replace all instances of "Thumb Gore" in its stat block with "Horn Gore".

items.name: The Bone Wars
entries: One of two greedy palaeontologists (Marsh or Cope) refuse to allow anyone to study Iguanodon's remains and have hidden explosives on every member of this species. If Iguanodon is slain, do not end combat. A loud ticking sound can be heard emanating from its remains and, after 2 rounds, they detonate with a large explosion, creating the following effect: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 15 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} from Iguanodon's remains. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Iganodon's remains are completed destroyed.

trait.name: Various Equipment
entries: Jeholrak {@item Defender|XDMG} may be equipped with one of the three options below. They may only use the attack associated with each equipment set:

items: Sleek Short Sword and {@spell Shield|XPHB} (also increase AC by 2)
Two-handed {@item Glaive|XPHB}
{@item Light Crossbow|XPHB}

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jeholrak Defender makes two attacks with one of its equipped weapons.

action.name: Sleek Short Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Two-handed Glaive
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 2}, range 60/100 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Conscript (1/Day)
entries: Jeholrak Defender calls a citizen to assist it. Choose another non-player character humanoid within 50 ft. of it that can see and hear Jeholrak Defender.

Jeholrak Defender makes a {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} check with a DC equal to the target humanoid's Charisma score. If that humanoid has a Lawful alignment, then Jeholrak Defender makes this {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} check at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. If successful, the humanoid must assist Jeholrak Defender however they can for 1 minute, but will not harm an ally of theirs.

action.name: Calming Pheromones (1/Day)
entries: Jeholrak Defender casts {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} (level 1 version, spell save {@dc 11}).

trait.name: In Plain Sight
entries: When first encountered, the Jeholrak Infiltrator will be disguised as an unarmed Jeholrak Politician. A {@variantrule Passive Perception|XPHB} of 18+ will reveal that they are in fact an assassin. Alternatively, a {@skill Perception|XPHB} check of 15+ or higher will reveal them if a creature is actively looking.
The Jeholrak Infiltrator may choose to take on the disguise of a Jeholrak Politician instead of hiding when they succeed on the {@skill Stealth|XPHB} check from the Hide action.

When Jeholrak Infiltrator attacks while disguised as a Jeholrak Politician, they attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and, if their first attack hits, it scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. The disguise is then lost at the end of Jeholrak Infiltrator's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jeholrak Infiltrator makes two attacks with any combination of its Gnarled Kriss attack and Razor Shuriken attack.

action.name: Gnarled Kriss
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage. If this attack was made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, it does an additional {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage.

action.name: Razor Shuriken
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 50 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage. If this attack was made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, it does an additional {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage.

action.name: Pheromonal Influence
entries: Jeholrak Infiltrator casts one of the following spells using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):
2/day each: {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB}

1/day: Suggestion Jeholrak Infiltrator may cast these spells without components (even while appearing as a Jeholrak Politician). The only indication that anything is happening is a slightly sweet smell in the air.

bonus.name: Flee The Scene!
entries: Jeholrak Infiltrator takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Practiced Charismatic Speaker
entries: Jeholrak Politician has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks and Charisma Saving Throws.

action.name: Feeble Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Command Defend
entries: Jeholrak Politician selects a friendly non-Jeholrak Politician creature within 30 ft. of it. That creature may move up to its maximum speed and take an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Demagogue (1/Day)
entries: Jeholrak Politician casts {@spell Mass Suggestion|XPHB} (level 6 version, spell save {@dc 13}) without material components. Player characters are unaffected by this spell unless they are currently {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by Jeholrak Politician.

action.name: Pheromonal Influence
entries: Jeholrak Politician casts one of the following spells using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):
2/day: {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB}
1/day: {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} (also see Demagogue) Jeholrak Politician may cast these spells without components. The only indication that anything is happening is a slightly sweet smell in the air.

trait.name: Nocturnal
entries: Juravenator has Darkvision 120 ft. (included above) and can see as if in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} up to 60 ft. It is generally only active at night and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity Saving Throws and Dexterity checks.

trait.name: Fatty Water-Wader
entries: Juravenator has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage (included above) and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures submerged in water that are smaller than itself.

action.name: Quick Snap
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Quick Reflexes
entries: Juravenator takes the Dash action.

items.name: Adult Form: Borb
entries: Juravenator has a chubby and puffed-up feathered appearance. Double its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, movement speed, to-hit bonus, and its damage becomes {@dice 1d4}. Juravenator has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning damage and its size category is Small.

items.name: Familiar
entries: Alternatively, you can choose to not increase Juravenator's CR and remove the Adult Form: Borb optional rule. Juravenator may then be used as a familiar via the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell or any similar effect. If you wish, it may still maintain the appearance described in Adult Form: Borb.

items.name: Quick Snap
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4} Piercing damage.

trait.name: Sexually Dimorphic
entries: Male and female Kentrosaurus differ in appearance. In a herd of 3 or more Kentrosaurus, select 1-2 animals to be male. They are a different colour than the females.

trait.name: Anterior-Facing Spikes
entries: A creature attacking Kentrosaurus does not gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} for any Trait or effect that would grant them {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks for outnumbering or flanking Kentrosaurus.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kentrosaurus (A) makes two Thagomise attacks, or (B) makes a single Tailsweep attack.

action.name: Thagomise
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Tailsweep
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft., up to three targets. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Reactionary Strike
entries: {@actTrigger} Kentrosaurus is hit by a melee attack roll. {@actResponse} Kentrosaurus makes a Thagomise attack against the attacking creature. If that attack hits, the creature suffers the following effect:

{@actSave cha} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The creature may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns. {@actSaveSuccess} The creature is immune to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition from Reactionary Strike for the next 24 hours.

items.name: The Hoodening
entries: Channelling Kentish folklore, Kentrosaurus is able to magically disguise itself as a horse. It will appear to be a wild horse to any observer. The disguise can be discerned by a {@dc 15} {@skill Investigation|XPHB} check, or is revealed when Kentrosaurus attacks.

While Kentrosaurus is disguised as a horse, any creature that attempts to mount or ride it suffers {@damage 2d10} Piercing damage and the disguise is revealed. If a creature otherwise attempts to touch Kentrosaurus, they take {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage and are made aware that something is amiss.

trait.name: Snatch Feeder
entries: If Klobiodon is flying, it does not provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Tooth Cage
entries: If Klobiodon hits a creature with its Toothed Gnaw attack, Klobiodon can opt to grasp onto it. Whenever that creature moves, Klobiodon moves with it (without using any of its own movement) and is considered to be occupying the same space as it. While grasping onto a creature, Klobiodon's AC is 10.

As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, the hit creature may make a {@dc 8} Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} to remove Klobiodon, ending this effect and pushing Klobiodon 5 ft. directly away from it on a success. Alternatively, Klobiodon may choose to end this effect at any time.

A creature with Klobiodon grasping onto it has its movement speed reduced by 5 ft. and takes {@damage 1d2} Piercing damage at the start of each of their turns. These effects are cumulative if more than one Klobiodon is grasping a single creature.

action.name: Toothed Gnaw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Hiding in Plain Sight
entries: Klobiodon's fossils sat unassigned to a new species for decades in a museum drawer. As long as Klobiodon is motionless, it has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition. In the first round of combat, if Klobiodon was {@condition Invisible|XPHB} at the start of the round, its Toothed Gnaw deals an additional {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage this round.

trait.name: River Skulker
entries: Kulindadromeus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Stealth checks while in thick foliage and can take the Hide action in sparse foliage or shallow water that would normally be too exposed to hide in. It also has Darkvision 40 ft. and a {@variantrule Passive Perception|XPHB} of 16 (both included above).

trait.name: Protofeathered Wader
entries: Reduce any Cold damage Kulindadromeus takes by {@dice 1d4} and it is not slowed by muddy {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

action.name: Beaked Chomp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Progenitor of Giants
entries: Kulindadromeus is among the first of the major herbivore lineage Ornithischia. All other herbivores within this lineage (Heterodontosaurs, Stegosaurs, Ankylosaurs, Iguanodontids, Hadrosaurs, etc. (e.g. Bolong, Iguanodon, Kentrosaurus, Scelidosaurus, Struthiosaurus, and Zuul in this book)) treat Kulindadromeus as a close relative and will protect it with their lives. They will ward off any threats to Kulindadromeus and ensure that it can feed safely.

trait.name: Deep Diver
entries: Leptonectes can hold its breath for 2 hours and has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold and Thunder damage (included above).

trait.name: Large Fusiform
entries: While in water, Leptonectes cannot be {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by creatures smaller than itself and has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of the spells {@spell Control Water|XPHB} and {@spell Tsunami|XPHB} (or similar effects, included above).

action.name: Snout Skewer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Piercing damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage if Leptonectes swarm 40+ ft. straight towards the target immediately before the hit.

action.name: Giant Paddle Slap
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, each other creature within a 5 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of Leptonectes. {@actSaveFail} 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Thunder damage.

items.name: Grimace
entries: Leptonectes grimaces with its down-turned jaw, creating the following effect: {@actSave cha} {@dc 11}, each other creature within a 20 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can see Leptonectes. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Sneering Swipe
entries: Leptonectes swims up to 5 ft., then makes a Snout Skewer attack (this attack cannot benefit from from the additional damage).

trait.name: Venomous Miasma
entries: A faint purple mist emanates from between Limukin Champion's armour plates. Each non-Limukin creature that starts its turn within or comes within 10 ft. of Limukin Champion must succeed a {@dc 16} Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} or become {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} for 1 minute. Limukin Champion has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage (included above) and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Stealth checks.

trait.name: Grapple Wire
entries: Limukin Champion can use a grappling rope to scale trees and traverse canopies with ease. It has a climb speed of 30 ft. (included above) and can jump up to 25 ft. from standing still. This Grapple Wire can also be used to snare and pull at enemies.

trait.name: Raging
entries: While in combat, Limukin Champion has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage (included above).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Limukin Champion makes three attacks with its Dinosaur Bone Greatsword.

action.name: Dinosaur Bone Greatsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Poison damage.

action.name: Grapple Wire
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage. A Small or Medium hit creature has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) and is pulled 10 ft. towards Limukin Champion. If that creature was flying, it is harmlessly pulled to the ground.

reaction.name: Parrying Guard
entries: {@actTrigger} Limukin Champion is hit by an attack. {@actResponse} Limukin Champion reduces the damage of that attack by {@dice 1d10}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Limukin Worldshaper casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Venom Unbound
entries: When Limukin Worldshaper dies, a poison cloud seeps from its body. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each non-Limukin creature creature in a 20 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Defender of the World
entries: Limukin Worldshaper has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom Saving Throws and may attack with its Maelstrom Rod as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Maelstrom Rod
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 2d6 + 3}) (see below) damage.
Roll a {@dice D6} and consult the list below to determine the damage type of this attack.

items: Cold
Fire
Lightning
Thunder
Acid
Force

trait.name: Toxic Secretion
entries: Any creature that hits Limukin Young Hunter with a melee attack takes {@damage 1d4} Poison damage. Limukin Young Hunter also has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage (included above).

trait.name: Young and Naive
entries: Limukin Young Hunter has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence and Wisdom Saving Throws.

trait.name: Natural Hunter
entries: Limukin Young Hunter can use its Dexterity modifier for {@skill Nature|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, and {@skill Survival|XPHB} checks (included above).

action.name: Toxin-Coated Slingshot
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

action.name: Skinning Knife
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Vinerope Net
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, one creature within 20 ft. of Limukin Young Hunter. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 11}).

trait.name: Death by Yucca
entries: Any creatures composed of or based on plants have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against Ludodactylus.

trait.name: Piscivorous Snatch Feeder
entries: Ludodactylus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures fully or partially submerged in water. If Ludodactylus is flying, it does not provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ludodactylus makes two Toothed-Beak Bite attacks and one Projectile Vomit attack.

action.name: Toothed-Beak Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Projectile Vomit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 15 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Acid damage.

action.name: Snatch
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 11}, one creature within 5 ft. of Ludodactylus while it is flying. {@actSaveFail} Ludodactylus snatches a small object (i.e. a Potion or pouch) that the target has visible on them (such as on their belt) and holds it its beak.

bonus.name: Quad Launch (Ludodactylus)
entries: If it is standing on the ground, Ludodactylus launches itself into the air. {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, each other creature in a 5 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Ludodactylus flies 15 ft. in a straight line.
Ludodactylus can only begin flying by using this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or if it is falling.

items.name: Bred for War
entries: Ludodactylus have been specially bred for combat. It can be equipped with Heavy Armor, increasing its AC to 18, but its fly speed is reduced to 35 ft. Ludodactylus takes on a heavily armoured appearance.

Ludodactylus can also be mounted by any Small humanoid. If it is mounted by an NPC, they are armed with a lance and Ludodactylus can use its {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make one of the following attacks:

items.name: Mounted Lance
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Lancing Projectile
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) Force damage.

trait.name: Pint-Sized Powerhouse
entries: Magyarosaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength Saving Throws.

action.name: Rear Up
entries: Magyarosaurus rears up onto its hind limbs. Its speed is reduced to 10 ft. and it is able to use its Mighty Stomp attack until it is no longer rearing up.
If Magyarosaurus attacks it lands on all fours and it ceases rearing up.

action.name: Neck Bludgeon
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mighty Stomp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d6 + 12}) Bludgeoning damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
Magyarosaurus must be rearing up to use this attack.

reaction.name: Sweeping Defence
entries: {@actTrigger} Magyarosaurus is hit by a Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Magyarosaurus makes a Neck Bludgeon attack against the attacking creature.

items.name: Dynamic Camouflage (2/Day)
entries: Magyarosaurus casts {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} (level 2 version) targeting itself without requiring components or a spell slot.

trait.name: Guild Knowledge
entries: Any party member known by a member of Guild Broker's guild for at least 24 hours is also known by Guild Broker. Additionally, Guild Broker knows any details that other members of its guild have learnt about them.

trait.name: Shrewd Negotiator
entries: Guild Broker has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Persuasion checks and has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition (included above).

trait.name: Hip-Shooter
entries: An enemy being within 5 ft. of Guild Broker does not cause it to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} when making a Ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB} with its Concealed Hand Crossbow. Guild Broker's Concealed Hand Crossbow is Hidden until fired.

action.name: Broke Peace
entries: Guild Broker calls for a truce. Each enemy that can hear Guild Broker and understands at least one of the languages that Guild Broker speaks must succeed a {@dc 11} Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} or consider Guild Broker to no longer be an enemy and may not attack Guild Broker (or any member of Guild Broker's guild), unless it or one of its guild Members attacks first or otherwise breaks the peace. A creature that is particularly hostile to Guild Broker makes its Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Guild Broker makes two Concealed Hand Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Concealed Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 30/120, one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Piercing damage. If this weapon was Hidden when Guild Broker attacked, the first attack is made at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage if it hits.

action.name: Horn Skewer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, {@variantrule Reach|XPHB} 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Flush Crest (2/Day)
entries: Guild Broker flushes its head crest with blood, giving itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks for the next 1 minute.

reaction.name: Horned Repose
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature misses Guild Broker with a melee attack. {@actResponse} Guild Broker makes a Horn Skewer attack at the attacking creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Guild Elder casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Guild Knowledge
entries: Any party member known by a member of Guild Elder's guild for at least 24 hours is also known by Guild Elder. Additionally, Guild Elder knows any details that other members of its guild have learnt about them.

trait.name: Guild Master
entries: Any non-Guild Elder member of Guild Elder's guild will defend Guild Elder with their lives.

action.name: Horn Skewer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Ceremonial Guild Sword (+1)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Flush Crest (3/Day)
entries: Guild Elder flushes its head crest with blood, giving itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks for the next 1 minute.

bonus.name: Guild Command
entries: Guild Elder commands any other non-Guild Elder member of its guild who can hear it. That creature may immediately move up to its maximum speed and take an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Horned Repose
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature misses Guild Elder with a melee attack. {@actResponse} Guild Elder makes a Horn Skewer attack at the attacking creature.

trait.name: Guild Knowledge
entries: Any party member known by a member of Guild Initiate's guild for at least 24 hours is also known by Guild Initiate. Additionally, Guild Initiate knows any details that other members of its guild have learnt about them.

action.name: Guild Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Horn Skewer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Flush Crest (1/Day)
entries: Guild Initiate flushes its head crest with blood, giving itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks for the next 1 minute.

reaction.name: Horned Repose
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature misses Guild Initiate with a melee attack. {@actResponse} Guild Initiate makes a Horn Skewer attack at the attacking creature.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Mastodonsaurus can breathe in both air and water. When in water, it gains a +3 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws.

trait.name: Dermal Pressure Sensors
entries: While in water, Mastodonsaurus has Blindsight 30 ft. (included above).

trait.name: Perfect Ambusher
entries: While motionless at the bottom of a body of water, Mastodonsaurus is indistinguishable from the sediment. If it attacks from this position, it is always considered to be first in the initiative order (regardless of all other abilities, like the Alert feat), has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its first attack, and that attack deals an additional {@damage 1d10} Piercing damage.

action.name: Tusked Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Piercing damage and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}).

items.name: Gurgling Energies
entries: When a creature is hit by Mastodonsaurus' Tusked Bite, it suffers the following effect:

{@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} Roll a {@dice D4} on the table below. The hit creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage of a type corresponding to the result. Mastodonsaurus has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage type until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: King of its Time
entries: Megalosaurus was the arch-predator of the British Bathonian. It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against creatures that are the same size category as itself.
Scrotum humanum. Megalosaurus takes triple damage from the cantrip {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB}.

action.name: Combination Multiattack
entries: Megalosaurus makes two Predatory Strike attacks. However, each of those Predatory Strike attacks must choose a different damage type.

action.name: Predatory Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, {@variantrule Reach|XPHB} 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) (see below) damage.

Megalosaurus lashes out with one of its myriad attacks - headbutting, clawing, biting, or lashing with its tail. Predatory Strike's damage type becomes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing (Megalosaurus' choice).

legendary.name: Rampant Thrashing
entries: Megalosaurus takes the Disengage action and can move up to 10 ft.

legendary.name: Predatory Gile
entries: Megalosaurus positions itself to take down a target. Choose a creature it can see. If its next attack hits that creature, that creature is gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Curse: First of its Kind
entries: The first time a humanoid (including player characters) sees Megalosaurus while within 60 ft. of it, they are affected by a curse that causes them to momentarily lose all understanding of dinosaurs and other Mesozoic creatures (no save allowed). The curse persists for two rounds or until they take damage. For each creature afflicted, roll a {@dice d4} and consult the table below to determine how they behave:

items: Curious - The humanoid becomes unaware of any threat Megalosaurus poses. They cannot attack it or cast detrimental spells/cantrips against it and must move directly towards it if possible.

Threatened - On the humanoid's next turn, they must make a ranged or melee attack against Megalosaurus or cast a cantrip that targets it. If the humanoid has Multiattack, they instead only make a single attack.

Adoring - The humanoid must attempt to feed or heal Megalosaurus on their next turn. Megalosaurus can accept food as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and will then prioritise killing other creatures over any that have fed it or healed it.
Terrified - The humanoid becomes {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of Megalosaurus.

trait.name: Arboreal
entries: If Microraptor takes the Dash action, do not increase its fly speed, but instead triple its climb speed. Microraptor also has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Stealth checks while in a wooded or forested environment.

trait.name: Feathered and Evasive
entries: When making a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} to take half damage from an attack, spell, or effect, Microraptor instead takes no damage if the {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} is succeeded. Microraptor also has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage (included above).

action.name: Scratch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d2 + 1}) Slashing damage.

items.name: Shimmering Feathers (2/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} Microraptor is hit by a Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Microraptor uses its iridescent feathers to misdirect and confuse attackers. Increase its AC by 2 until the end of the turn.

trait.name: Speciose
entries: Early Titanosaurs diversified rapidly. Each time the party encounters a new Mnyamawamtuka (including this one), select or roll for an adaptation on the Minor Mutation Table. Apply that mutation to that Mnyamawamtuka. You do not need to increase Mnyamawamtuka's CR for the mutation gained.

trait.name: Columnar Limbs
entries: Mnyamawamtuka's strong legs make it exceedingly difficult to topple. It has an additional +5 modifier (total +12) and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Saving Throws to resist the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. However, Mnyamawamtuka has a further -3 modifier (total -5, included above) and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity Saving Throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mnyamawamtuka makes one Shoveling Bite attack and two Whipping Tail attacks.

action.name: Shovelling Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The hit creature drops an item it is wielding.

action.name: Whipping Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage.

items.name: Heart-Shaped Soul
entries: A creature hit by one of Mnyamawamtuka's attacks suffers the following effect:

{@actSave cha} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature will fetch food for Mnyamawamtuka. Once this charm ends, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Diver
entries: Mosasaurus can hold its breath for up to 2 hours.

trait.name: Ocean Tyrant
entries: Mosasaurus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Mighty Jaw attacks against other creatures native to an ocean setting.

trait.name: Stormrider
entries: Mosasaurus has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage, and has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of {@spell Control Water|XPHB} and {@spell Tsunami|XPHB} (included above).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mosasaurus makes one Mighty Jaw attack and one Concussive Splash attack.

action.name: Mighty Jaw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Piercing damage, plus: {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Piercing damage (from Mosasaurus' palatal teeth).

action.name: Concussive Splash
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 20 ft. {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) Thunder damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: Rogue Wave (1/Day)
entries: If a storm is present, Mosasaurus casts the spell {@spell Tsunami|XPHB} (level 8 version) without requiring components or a spell slot.

items.name: Stormbringer
entries: Mosasaurus creates a storm centered on itself that has a radius of 1 mile and persists for 1 hour.

trait.name: Ocean Farer
entries: Nothosaurus has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold and Thunder damage (included above).

trait.name: Diverse
entries: Nothosaurus come in a variety of colours with different skin patterns.

trait.name: Aquatic Reptile
entries: Nothosaurus can hold its breath for up to 10 minutes and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity Saving Throws while submerged in water.

trait.name: Basking
entries: If Nothosaurus spends at least 10 minutes basking in the sun on land, it gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Nothosaurus makes two Piercing Bite attacks and one Neck Whack attack.

action.name: Piercing Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Neck Whack
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Dive
entries: Nothosaurus swims up to 15 ft.

items.name: Charged Skin
entries: Nothosaurus has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Lightning damage.

items.name: Spit Lightning
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 100 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) Lightning damage.

items.name: Lightning Overload {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, each creature within a 15 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Handless
entries: Nyctosaurus has only one finger on each hand, which is used by its wing to support the membrane. It cannot climb any surface.

trait.name: Inter-Continental Migrator
entries: Nyctosaurus can fly for up to a week without needing to stop. It can sleep while flying, although its fly speed is reduced to 30 ft., and it can only fly in a straight line while it does so.

trait.name: Snatch Feeder
entries: If Nyctosaurus is flying, it does not provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Headcrest 'Antler' Crash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage.
Nyctosaurus may only perform this attack if it flew at least 50 ft. this turn.
When Nyctosaurus makes this attack, it lands on the ground.

action.name: Beaked Peck
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Aura of Blindsight
entries: Nyctosaurus has Blindsight 60 ft. Any other {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} Nyctosaurus within a 100 ft. {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has Blindsight 10 ft.

items.name: "Night Lizard" (2/Day)
entries: Nyctosaurus casts the spell {@spell Darkness|XPHB} (level 2 version) without requiring components or a spell slot. However, it automatically loses {@status Concentration|XPHB} if it takes damage.

trait.name: Brooder
entries: Oviraptor are excellent parents and fiercely territorial of their nests. If Oviraptor is defending its nest, it attacks recklessly, giving it {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attacks, but all attacks against it also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Oviraptor makes one Snapping Beak attack and one Clawed Scratch attack.

action.name: Snapping Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Clawed Scratch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Crested Head Flush (1/Day)
entries: Oviraptor flushes its crest with blood, giving it a vivid appearance. It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma Checks and Charisma Saving Throws for the next 1 minute.

reaction.name: Feathered
entries: {@actTrigger} When Oviraptor takes Bludgeoning damage from an attack or from falling. {@actResponse} Oviraptor reduces any Bludgeoning damage it takes from the attack by {@dice 1d4} or reduces any Bludgeoning damage it takes from falling by {@dice 2d10}.

items.name: Egg/Offspring Thief
entries: The original misinterpretation of Oviraptor as opportunistic egg thieves, when all evidence shows that they were actually attentive parents has left a bitter resentment within all Oviraptor.
